summary.intent: Land a fix for a review finding on PR 425 (change #223): replacing the addon's regex-based `wrappedDefaultOf` with extractor logic regressed `export default Object.assign(Root, {...})` defaults, so the fix had to cover every shape the old regex followed.
summary.outcome: A subagent pushed the fix as 3552dd38 (signed) to fix/anonymous-default-identity and marked the finding resolved. The PR 425 body was updated with a follow-up section; its checks show no failures but 15 are still pending, so it isn't confirmed green.

repo: The extractor had two separate lists of calls that return the component they are given: the default-export follower in `uses.rs` and the alias detector in `component.rs`. Only the alias detector knew `Object.assign`, so the two drifted apart.

Now `is_component_alias_call` (wrappers plus `Object.assign`) and `aliased_component` (first argument) in `extractor/component.rs` are the single definition. `uses.rs` and `alias_shape` call them. `wrapper.rs` shares the wrapper half via `is_component_wrapper`, and `is_component_wrapper_call` is now private.
A default export of `Object.assign` also attaches its statics, so `default.Item` resolves.

`styled(X)`, `makePanel(X)` and `wrap(1, X)` are not component wrappers, so they fall back through the 'found no component default in …; its components are …' message, which `provider.test.ts` already asserts. The old regex followed them, mostly wrongly. This is a behavior change.
`CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION` needs no bump here: the stored shape is unchanged and the PR's own move to 37 covers the changed extraction. No golden or construct row changed.
`session.test.ts` uses a fake binding, so its cases pass with or without the Rust fix and are not failed-before evidence.

The repo's check commands are `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `just semver`, `just test-checker-lane`, `just test-construct`, `just test-ts`, `just test-napi` and `just test-integration`. Nextest needs `TSRS_BIN` set.
PR check status excludes the 'Entire Gates' check, which waits on the user's approval.

code.finding: Holds the shared `is_component_alias_call`, `aliased_component` and `is_component_wrapper`, replacing the duplicated call lists in `uses.rs` and `alias_shape`.
Gained a case for a default export wrapped by a component alias.

workflow: When replacing a heuristic such as a regex with structured logic, enumerate every shape the old one accepted and add a test for each. This caught the `Object.assign` regression.
Distinguish failed-before evidence from tests that pass either way: the fake-binding test does not prove the fix, while the extractor test and the Menu integration test do.
Subagent reports were relayed into the PR body and the summary with explicit callouts of what was untested, not verified or not waited on (CI, oracle runs, corpus fetch).

friction: The fake-binding `session.test.ts` case cannot show the fix works, so failed-before evidence had to come from the extractor and integration tests.
CI was not waited on: 15 checks on #425 are still pending, so green is unconfirmed.
The behavior change for `styled(X)`, `makePanel(X)` and `wrap(1, X)` has to be flagged to the user.
